title: Cyberwave Contract Id
description: The id of a contract, as a field such as `execution_contract`, `output_contract` or `input_contract` names it. Generated by python3 -m cyberwave_contracts._contract_ids; do not edit by hand. Most members are the manifest's payload contracts. These are ids production already uses that no contract defines yet, so they have no schema: actuator.channels.normalized.v1, control.free_body_velocity.v1, control.joint_state.v1, control.joint_target.v1, locomotion.cmd_vel.v1, locomotion.joint_target.v1, manipulation.language_instruction.v1, manipulation.pick_place.v1, perception.locate_object.v1, pose.mirror.kinematic.v1.
